steps.text: Unknown time

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You're not going to draw the curtains?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The glass has already been broken. Doing that would just be lying to myself.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: The glass doesn't matter. Whether Ch'en is safe... does matter.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She's skilled. Not like her father, or her mother.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yes, nothing like her.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Beneath my feet is already another river of lights. Lungmen has already returned to normal, but they still don't know what will happen next.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Alone, Ch'en Hui-chieh cannot stop this disaster.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Rhodes Island is with her. They will find her.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Witte can no longer hold back the conservatives. For so many years, he has tried to suppress the great lords, but he has not been able to completely defeat them. Only weaken them.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: After the Great Rebellion, a harsh blow was dealt to the generals of the various armies and the old nobles behind them. Their status and wealth will be absorbed by the State Council, one by one.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But I'm afraid that...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Afraid of what?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What if Witte is lying? What if this whole situation was plotted by Witte and the Emperor? What if the young emperor planned all of this?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Our enemies have always lurked in the shadows. But we've always had to stand before the brightest spotlight.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You are already deeper into the shadows than most others.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...It's not enough. Just like back then. If Kashchey... if he was in this situation, he'd burrow deeper.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But you are not Kashchey. Kashchey would not have been able to make Lungmen what it is today.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: It's just that... if Tal... If Tal really was taught by Kashchey...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: That doctor from Rhodes Island, do you think she's lying?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm not sure. There aren't many people like that who don't lie. Rhodes Island is good at hiding itself. They feign weakness before us and will not reveal any secrets.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But, I would rather believe that Kashchey shaped the current Talulah. We can't afford the terrible consequences of underestimating the enemy.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Because of that, I can't let Ch'en Hui-chieh do this alone.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Kashchey... has all the cards in his hand. Even if he is dead, his vision may yet come to pass through his heir.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: None of this could be what he wanted.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The scout team reported that some of the Infected who left Lungmen were moving in the direction of the core city.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The core city must stop for a period of time, during which they receive these Infected refugees.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Even if Talulah bared her vicious fangs at Ursus, she would not betray Reunion in front of everyone. This is the best opportunity.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will bring the Shadow Guard.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You?!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: They've already done too much for me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I promised that I'd never ask them to dirty their hands, only to break that promise again and again.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And now, I would ask them to die for Lungmen?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...If so, I will be with them.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I won't allow it.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You doing that would play right into Kashchey's hands. That would not be a win at all.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Is it not a stretch to say that everything we've done since regaining Lungmen has played into Kashchey's hands?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We've won before.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It was our victory at first. Even though it was painful, you and I, Edward, and Kojui... Without us, he would've wiped out this city.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I never once regarded this incident as an unfortunate beginning.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...I won't treat Edward's death as if it was by Kashchey's hands.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Would you rather treat it as a nightmare?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The nightmare should have finally ended when Kashchey died.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Is he really dead?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Maybe he lives on in Talulah. A qualified successor will allow him to continue his life of chaos.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Talulah is too much like him. For someone who had no children, Kashchey truly received the most suitable seed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Even if I can treat Kal'tsit's words as fabrications, I cannot deny the facts. There is a conspiracy against Lungmen, and it reads too much like Kashchey's handwriting.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I don't believe it. Tal has never been that kind of person. Why is she doing this?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We have no choice but to believe it. Talulah planned all of this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But if she thinks Lungmen will roll over and die, she will find she is sadly mistaken.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lungmen will not fall. I won't let any harm come to Lungmen.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But, you also cannot stop this war.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Do you want me to die with you?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki?!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Are you threatening me?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Ah, no. That's not what I meant. It's just that...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No! You can't!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Only cowards would elevate themselves on the corpses of others.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And, without you... I wouldn't be able to...!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Maybe I was a coward before, but not anymore, Fumizuki.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I won't let anyone lay a finger on you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'll find a place for you to hide. Be it Leithanien, or Sargon, or Sami...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You can't go back to Higashi. I'll send you to a distant country, to a small, quiet town that nobody knows about.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'll hide you where nobody can follow you. My brother... no matter how much he hates me, he won't chase you to the ends of the earth... I know he won't.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But, I can't live like that.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Do you want me to spend my life alone, Yenwu?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Do you want to torture me with your death for the rest of my life? Don't you remember why your sister died?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, no... Fumizuki, I want you to live. I...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Wei Yenwu, I told you... I'm fine with it.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: To die with you would already be the best terrible outcome I can imagine. Or rather, no matter how terrible it is, it'll be a fine ending for me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Don't say that, Fumizuki...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I won't be that kind of person. I won't let you do that either.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But you know, you can't stop me. You've never been able to stop me from doing what I want to do.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki...!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yenwu, you've always been frank with me. Sometimes, you won't tell me anything, when you finally come out with it, I'll always know that you're telling me the truth.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I don't want you to die. But I also don't want Tal to die. I don't want any of us to die.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I miss Tal. I'm always reminded of how much she looks like your sister. But, she has Edward's eyes, and that temper she had when she was little... I have no idea who she got that from. It's been so, so many years since I've seen her.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: We owe all of this to her.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...and Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yes, and Little Ch'en as well.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Little Ch'en is gone, and I won't be able to see her ever again... I'll never be able to buy her beautiful clothes and comb her hair into a work of art.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She... She didn't like traditional attire that much.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But, I liked it. How beautiful, how beautiful she will be.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: ...But even if that's the case, even if we've said our final farewell, I hope that Little Ch'en can find someplace else to settle down comfortably. That's what I hope.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I know you don't want to rely on Rhodes Island, and I know that you won't hedge all your bets on them.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But I want you to wait for a while.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: And let them do this, Yenwu.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: If they fail, then we shall go together. You don't want to have the blood of your loved ones on your hands ever again, right?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: If that happens, I will help you take Tal's life. Then, we will die together.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki...!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You want her to live as well, don't you? Is this Lungmen a place that wants all of us to die?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I would rather never see them again. I would rather never see Little Ch'en and Tal again and forget about them... but I also want them to live on.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Just like you. Just like you wanted me to make this decision.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki. If things pass the tipping point, you must listen to my arrangements. Our lives... are not indivisible.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Of course not, Yenwu. I do not solely exist for you.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Everything I've done, from beginning to end, has not only been for your sake.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You must see what I am fighting for.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Don't dodge the issue anymore. Look at me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will stick to my decision...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Do you want to cry?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: It's fine to cry, Yenwu.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, Fumizuki. No...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Be honest.
There are people who simply want to rest and find refuge within a city. Why should they suffer needless death?
Don't we just want to give them a home? Don't we want all people like us, who have nowhere to go, to have a warm place to rest?
Did I not simply want to build a little city where everyone can live with peace of mind?
Who was Lungmen built for, the way it is now?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I am no moralist, Fumizuki. But the closer I look, the more I realize that only one death is needed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...My own.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Don't be like this! You mustn't!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will have the Shadow Guard escort you to Sargon.
When did Lungmen turn into this?
And... when did I become like this?
